comments:
e13590e9:  ;This routine is used for pre and post-installation checks and clean-up.
 ;It ensures the environment is correctly set up before installation begins
 ;and performs necessary clean-up and set-up after installation.
eed3ae0b:  ;Start of the environment check routine.
1a31b8f3: ;Initialize the XPDABORT variable to an empty string.
32c48eaa: ;Ensure the user's DUZ is set, DUZ(0) is '@', today's date is set, and U is '^'.
89d39fb1: ;Display a message prefix.
c78c7503: ;Inform the installer that their environment variables are improperly set.
8340ba10: ;Notify the installer that the installation process is aborted.
b9ccb90a: ;Indicate that the environment check has passed.
1ce6974d: ;Exit the environment check routine.

a09cd1e0:  ;ABRT label for handling aborting the installation.
 ;Sets the XPDABORT variable to signal the installation should be aborted.
39b31e2b: ;Set the abort flag and exit the routine.

db702cbf:  ;PRE label for the pre-installation routine.
 ;Used to clean up existing data structures or settings before the new installation.
166f1d2f: ;Specify the file and field to be deleted prior to installation.
9802bf67: ;Execute the deletion command.
abff6835: ;Exit the pre-installation routine.

603c4c4a:  ;POST label for the post-installation routine.
 ;Used for setting up new structures or data post-installation.
7ec34810: ;Initialize variables for the DIC lookup.
1aa33882: ;Set the DIC lookup parameters.
f4c11c51: ;Define the option to be put 'out of order'.
af44f466: ;Look up the option, exit if not found.
d7137055: ;Display a message prefix.
3214408b: ;Inform the installer of the option being disabled.
53a08ba3: ;Define the 'out of order' message.
e8834ab6: ;Disable the option in the menu.
8af8f1b8: ;Exit the post-installation routine.
